data.name: MppUploader_Display_Name
data.value: MPP Uploader

data.name: MppUploader_Description
data.value: Imports project plans and browses projects from a configured Project Online PWA site.

data.name: FunctionUrl_Display_Name
data.value: Azure Function URL

data.name: FunctionUrl_Description
data.value: Full HTTPS URL of the MPP import Azure Function.

data.name: FunctionKey_Display_Name
data.value: Azure Function Key

data.name: FunctionKey_Description
data.value: Optional Function Key sent through the x-functions-key header. Leave empty when the URL already contains ?code=.

data.name: CopyProjectFunctionUrl_Display_Name
data.value: Copy Project Function URL

data.name: CopyProjectFunctionUrl_Description
data.value: Full HTTPS URL used by Import from Project. It may include the ?code= Function Key.

data.name: EnvironmentsFunctionUrl_Display_Name
data.value: Environments Function URL

data.name: EnvironmentsFunctionUrl_Description
data.value: Full HTTPS URL (GET) that returns the destination environments as a JSON array of { name, url }. It may include the ?code= Function Key.

data.name: TargetEnvironments_Display_Name
data.value: Target Environments (JSON)

data.name: TargetEnvironments_Description
data.value: Fallback list used when no Environments Function URL is set. JSON array, e.g. [{"name":"UAT","url":"https://org.crm.dynamics.com"}].

data.name: ExcelFunctionUrl_Display_Name
data.value: Excel Function URL

data.name: ExcelFunctionUrl_Description
data.value: Full HTTPS URL used by Import from Excel. It may include the ?code= Function Key.

data.name: TestConnectionFunctionUrl_Display_Name
data.value: Test Connection Function URL

data.name: TestConnectionFunctionUrl_Description
data.value: Full HTTPS URL of the Test Connection Azure Function. It may include the ?code= Function Key.

data.name: PwaProjectsFunctionUrl_Display_Name
data.value: Project Online Projects Function URL

data.name: PwaProjectsFunctionUrl_Description
data.value: Optional HTTPS endpoint used to load projects from the configured PWA site.

data.name: PwaProjectTasksFunctionUrl_Display_Name
data.value: Project Online Tasks Function URL

data.name: PwaProjectTasksFunctionUrl_Description
data.value: Optional HTTPS endpoint used to load tasks for an expanded Project Online project.

data.name: PwaConnectionPageName_Display_Name
data.value: Project Online Connection Page Name

data.name: PwaConnectionPageName_Description
data.value: Logical name of the Custom Page used to let users authorize their Project Online connection.

data.name: MaxFileSizeMb_Display_Name
data.value: Maximum file size (MB)

data.name: MaxFileSizeMb_Description
data.value: Maximum accepted MPP or Excel file size in megabytes. Default: 210.

data.name: RequestTimeoutSeconds_Display_Name
data.value: Request timeout (seconds)

data.name: RequestTimeoutSeconds_Description
data.value: Maximum time to upload the file and wait for the initial Azure Function response. Default: 600 seconds.
